title: Delta characters and crystalline cohomology of abelian schemes
summary: We provide an explicit description of the smallest filtered sub-isocrystal generated by the Hodge filtered piece of the crystalline cohomology for an abelian scheme over a $p$-adic ring. Our method is based on the theory of arithmetic jet spaces and delta characters associated to the abelian scheme, introduced by Buium and later studied by Borger and Saha using a functor of points approach.
